# Son input-only acceptance fixture

This directory is a non-canonical, input-only authoring fixture. `first-note-request.json` is the sole repository copy of its authored body, Source observations, and requested Entity operations.

Tests may copy this request into a disposable downstream repository, materialize a Candidate, apply it, validate the resulting instance, and then remove every temporary output. Nothing generated from this fixture may be tracked, snapshotted, packaged, published, or used as a synthetic package or Pages fixture.

The original prose in this directory is covered by the path-scoped notice in [`CONTENT_LICENSE.md`](../../../CONTENT_LICENSE.md). Third-party Source bodies are not copied here.
